title: Looking for an MV style submarine vehicle sprite

posts.author: DaKingPiglet
posts.body:
I'm looking for a dark blue and gray submarine in the MV style that's rideable by the player. I've looked around and haven't been able to find much. All I need are the 12 sprites to make up the animation for the sub to move.
If it could be slightly submerged hat would also be great. If anyone could help out that would be much appreciated.

posts.author: hiddenone
Animebryan
posts.body:
hiddenone said:
@DaKingPiglet Do not use that submarine in your game.
Click to expand...
Wow! Imagine having the audacity to tell someone what they can or can't use in their game. I found that sub sprite on the internet ages ago and found it perfect when I couldn't find one anywhere else. I had no idea it was from FFV.
But telling someone what they can or can't use in their game is bullshit! You may not like sprite rips from commercial games included or distributed either in a game or as a resource, but there are plenty of developers who focus on making fangames of commercial series like FF and Dragon Quest, so it's only natural that resources from said games would be made available for use in programs like RPG Maker. Spriter's Resource is dedicated to offering such resources.
Developers should have a right to include whatever they want in their games, excluding of course plagiarized resources from other artists. In the case of copyrighted series like FF, let Square Enix worry about and deal with their content. Most games that uses copyrighted content are so under the radar that the copyright holders don't even notice or even care, as long as said fangame and/or resources aren't being used to make money.

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
I am so glad
@RCXGaming
posted before me cause I was a little out of words.
This submarine is made from scratch, so I can guarantee there are no issues with it :3 Though, I know I say that a lot in this section, I can highly recommend using the
resource request template
to help the people helping you.
I have to say I had no idea which part was supposed to be grey and which blue without a reference, so I went for a generic all grey one so most people in a modern setting can have a use for it. It comes in "floaty underwater vehicle for underwater maps", "swimming" and "underwater on overworld maps".
Be sure to follow my terms of use as in my
MZ thread
(minus owning MZ, as said, it is from scratch).
